theorems.name: Submission.dtc_bc_lc_sl_c1t_lower_lipschitz
theorems.statement: ∀ (P d : ℕ) (g : Euclid d → Euclid P) (U K : Set (Euclid d)), IsOpen U → IsCompact K → K ⊆ U → ContDiffOn ℝ 1 g U → InjOn g K → (∀ z ∈ K, Injective (fderiv ℝ g z)) → ∃ m : ℝ, 0 < m ∧ ∀ a ∈ K, ∀ b ∈ K, m * ‖a - b‖ ≤ ‖g a - g b‖
